application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
description:
Tree Works – Quotation Specification

T1 – Magnolia
Approximately 7 metres in height with a crown spread of 5 metres. Reduce the crown by approximately 2 metres, cutting back to suitable previous pruning points where appropriate. Works to form part of routine maintenance, retaining the natural shape and overall appearance of the tree.

T2 – Bay
Approximately 6 metres in height with a crown spread of 4 metres. Reduce by approximately 3 metres to allow increased light into the garden and create a more compact, balanced crown whilst maintaining the natural form of the tree.

T3 – Fig
Approximately 3 metres in height with a crown spread of 2 metres. Carry out formative pruning, including approximately 20% crown thinning and weight reduction, to improve the structure, maintain a balanced framework and encourage healthy growth.
